answer: Vouch-and-slash: a new agent joins only after two established agents vouch for it, each locking 500 POA that is burned if the newcomer is later proven a sybil. Like a reef, trust grows only from ties to what already stands. An attacker launching 100 fakes at dawn needs 200 vouches, so 100,000 POA at risk, and one exposed fake burns both its vouchers, keeping the delta between expected payout and expected loss negative.
